text: Figure B. The ceiling, computed rather than quoted. A trace of the given width laid down the skeleton of the human's own paint is the best answer a detector could give if the paint marks where the crack is but not how wide the brush was. Scored against that paint on the same 26 tiles from 13 specimens at 0 px tolerance, pooled IoU peaks at 0.4993 at 11 px: IoU above 0.8 is unreachable on this corpus by any model whatsoever. The ceiling is itself a reporting choice — as the median over tiles it is 0.5498 at 7 px — so the detector's 0.3344 pooled is 67% of the pooled ceiling and its 0.4189 tile-median is 76% of the tile-median one; the two must not be crossed. clDice barely notices, holding 0.865 even for a trace drawn 41 px wide, and skeleton-F1 at 2 px stays above 0.98 out to 11 px before the skeleton of a deliberately fattened trace starts to wander.
